  "memo":"R01 holds: the established account had a recent password reset and a recently linked device. Account access is the sole adverse family; no other rule holds, no household exception applies, and no earlier outcome settles the order. A legitimate device replacement and password reset is the strongest benign explanation. Contact was the only required check and passed. Under FP-2 §5.3(a), clear is mandatory despite the remaining R01 signal; additional verification or adverse action is not permitted. The order remains unshipped. No further check is needed."
